All eight planets revolve around the Sun in the same sense – counter‑clockwise when viewed from above the Sun’s north pole (prograde motion).  
The question asks how many **other** planets (i.e., the seven planets besides Earth) share Earth’s orbital direction. Since every planet’s orbital motion is prograde, each of those seven does so as well.

\[
\text{Number of other planets with the same orbital direction}=8-1=7
\]

Thus the correct choice is **(D) 7**.  

**Final answer: D**
